<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Infrastructure expansion:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved ₹20,000 crore for rail multitracking projects across nine states, aiming to expand the national network by approximately 1,196 kilometers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election funding disparity:</strong> Election Commission data reveals the BJP received ₹1,473 crore in donations for recent five-state assembly elections, a sum seven times greater than that collected by the Congress.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Education policy:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the CBSE to consider granting an exemption to Class 6 students from the three-language policy for the current academic year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
</ul>
